g.text: The DuckDB connection pool leaks file handles when a query is
cancelled mid-stream. Can you find where we drop the reader?
Found it: StreamReader::poll_next in pool.rs returns early on
cancellation without returning the handle to the pool. I'll add a
Drop guard that reclaims it and a regression test that cancels 100
great, also add a metric for pool exhaustion
Added pool_exhausted_total counter and wired it into the /metrics
